description: This Java class defines a simple Android ListActivity named List1 that displays a list of cheese names from a static array. It sets up an ArrayAdapter to bind the string array to the list view and enables text filtering.

classes.name: List1
classes.description: An Android ListActivity displaying a list of cheese names using ArrayAdapter.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the list adapter with an array of cheese names, and enables text filtering.
